items.title: 1.3 Salient Features of Kingdoms of Domain Eukarya

source_refs.note: Topic 1.3, printed pages 7-10 (PDF 10-13): the four kingdoms of Eukarya with their side notes, Figure 1.8 and the table of distinguishing characteristics of the kingdoms of three domains.

blocks.text: Eukarya consists of kingdoms protista, fungi, plantae and animalia. It includes all eukaryotes which consist of complex, eukaryotic cells containing nucleus and other membrane-bound organelles.
